question: Has gateway 2026.7.1 passed the Windows Hub acceptance bar to become the setup engine’s new last-known-good version despite the newly reported upstream availability concerns?
rationale: Designating a release as last-known-good is a release-acceptance decision requiring real Windows setup evidence and judgment about upstream regressions; the code diff and static checks cannot establish that operational result.

options.title: Accept after Windows proof
options.body: Run the current-head Windows Hub setup path and merge only if exact installation, startup, RPC health, onboarding, and required repository validation pass.

options.title: Keep 2026.6.11 pinned
options.body: Defer the bump until the upstream 2026.7.1 availability reports are triaged or a later gateway release clears the Windows acceptance run.

recommendation.title: Accept after Windows proof
recommendation.body: Run the current-head Windows Hub setup path and merge only if exact installation, startup, RPC health, onboarding, and required repository validation pass.
